# RASHX | راش إكس

> RASHX (راش إكس) is a cloud management platform for beauty salons, beauty centers and spas in Saudi Arabia. It unifies bookings, CRM, HR and commissions, sales and POS, purchasing, inventory, loyalty, notifications and reports in one system, and supports ZATCA e-invoicing (Phase 2, subject to each facility's integration status). Founded in 2026 by Eng. Mohamed Abdo Rashad El-Bahy (محمد عبده رشاد البهي).

Each facility gets its own branded digital ecosystem on a RASHX subdomain: a public website, an admin dashboard, a customer app/portal and a service-provider (staff) app. Arabic is the default language; English pages use `?lang=en`.

## Facts
- Company: RASHX – راش إكس (technology and digital solutions for the beauty sector)
- Founded: 2026
- Founder: Mohamed Abdo Rashad El-Bahy (محمد عبده رشاد البهي), also known as Mohamed Rashad / محمد رشاد / محمد البهي; Egyptian software developer, born 1 December 2004 in Dakahlia, Egypt; studied Computer Science at the European University of Lefke (EUL); IEEE-certified
- Website: https://rashx.org
- Phone: +966 54 808 2945
- Market: Saudi Arabia
- Pricing: custom, quote-based (see /pricing)
